177: ```

117: ## Local Docker build
118: 
119: Build and push to GitHub Container Registry (GHCR):
120: 
121: ```sh
122: # Build only (also tags as commoncal:local)
123: make docker-build
124: 
125: # Push to GHCR (requires GHCR_TOKEN)
126: make docker-push
127: 
128: # Build and push
129: make docker-build-push
130: ```
131: 
132: Override the image tag:
133: 
134: ```sh
135: IMAGE_TAG=v1.2.3 make docker-build-push
136: ```
137: 
138: Set up GHCR authentication:
139: 
140: ```sh
141: # Option 1: export the token directly
142: export GHCR_TOKEN=ghp_xxx
143: 
144: # Option 2: use the GitHub CLI (token fetched automatically)
145: gh auth login
146: ```

148: The script `scripts/docker-build-push.sh` supports `--dry-run` and `--build-only` flags.

151: `make check` runs CI-parity checks on top of the build targets: `docker-check`

153: CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerabilities. `trivy-check` requires the `trivy` CLI; set
154: `SKIP_TRIVY=1` to skip the scan.

156: ### Multi-platform builds
157: 
158: Production nodes are x86_64 (amd64). Building on Apple Silicon (ARM64) without
159: explicit platform targeting produces an image that **cannot run on amd64 nodes**
160: (`no match for platform in manifest: not found`).

162: The build script targets both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` by default.
163: Override with the `PLATFORMS` env var if needed:

167: PLATFORMS=linux/amd64 make docker-build-push

169: # arm64 only (for ARM nodes)
170: PLATFORMS=linux/arm64 make docker-build-push
